recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中央一顆小型成熟淋巴球，核深染、胞質很窄，但藍色胞質內有數個清楚的圓形小空泡（vacuole）；在溶小體貯積症（如 Niemann-Pick）的背景下，空泡化淋巴球是重要線索。
features: Small mature lymphocyte with round nucleus, condensed chromatin and high N:C ratio
Narrow rim of pale blue cytoplasm containing several small, sharply punched-out clear vacuoles
No cytoplasmic granules or nuclear atypia
Background red cells mostly normocytic with a few paler irregular cells; scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small mature lymphocyte with a round nucleus, condensed chromatin and a narrow rim of pale blue cytoplasm containing multiple small, discrete, sharply defined clear vacuoles. No granules or nuclear atypia are present. Background red cells are mostly unremarkable with a few paler cells, and scattered platelets are seen. Vacuolated lymphocytes are nonspecific in isolation but, in the appropriate context (hepatosplenomegaly, foamy marrow macrophages), are suggestive of a lysosomal storage disorder such as Niemann-Pick disease.

ddx.vs: Storage-related vacuolation affects many cell types, especially neutrophils and monocytes, in aged samples, whereas storage-disease vacuoles appear in fresh smears and in a consistent proportion of lymphocytes.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, finely clumped chromatin and nucleoli, not small mature lymphocytes.

ddx.dx: Other storage disorders (Pompe, Wolman, mucopolysaccharidoses, neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis)
ddx.vs: Vacuolated lymphocytes are shared, so enzyme assays or genetic testing, plus clues such as Alder-Reilly granules in mucopolysaccharidoses, are needed to separate them.
